text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hah, yo, to... Pivot on the left foot 
here, tuck the body inward, no wasted 
motion... HAAH!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ehehe... Well, you see, this is 
training to go down stairs faster!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Do you know about the limited-edition 
banana sandwiches? Tomorrow for sure, I 
want to buy one before they sell out.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
So, to reach the school store even one 
second faster, I'm practicing the most 
efficient way to go down the stairs!
choice_data_list: ...How did you come up with such a...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No, I didn't discover it myself. The one 
who taught me these steps was—
choice_data_list: ...How did you ever find such a un...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heheh~! It was me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Teio-san! Thanks to you, I'm starting to 
get the hang of running down stairs fast!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I've been curious... 
Did you come up with this technique to
buy 
banana sandwiches too, Teio-san?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nope! In my case—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
There was a time when they were selling 
limited-edition Hachimii~

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So I used this technique to dash straight 
down and buy it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And actually,
I wasn't the one who came up 
with this method either—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Those steps Kita-san was doing just now, 
that's what I taught Teio-san, desu!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Spe-san! Did you devise this 
descending technique yourself, Spe-san?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's right, desu. You know how 
lunchtime always turns into an absolute 
battle?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... I missed out again... If only 
this place were our classroom,
I'd make it 
in time...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Just 5 more seconds... no,
if I could just 
rush down 2 seconds faster...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uwooooooh! Th-This is it, desu...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
In other words,
a secret technique created 
by Spe-san, passed down to Teio-san—and 
now inherited by me!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
it's really not that big of a deal. 
But still—I entrust it to you, Kita-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes! I promise I will completely 
master this stair-running technique!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes! I promise I will completely 
master this stair-running technique!
choice_data_list: Sprinting down in a single breath ...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Exactly... Doing repetitions drains 
stamina surprisingly fast...
choice_data_list: Sprinting down in a single breath ...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely tough to learn,
but... for 
the sake of delicious food, let's fight 
on, desu!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Besides, we're super happy to see 
Kita-chan carrying on our legacy!
Come on, 
give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that part's no problem at all! I'm 
pretty confident in my courage!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! As expected of you, Kita-san! You've 
got plenty of aptitude to master it, desu!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nishihi~ Since you're inheriting our 
legacy, that's the kind of confidence we 
want to hear!
